name: wathiq
description: Safe one-file bootstrap for Wathiq 0.2.0; preserves GitHub workflow files during Action-driven reset.

scripts.repo:clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),zlib=require('zlib'),cp=require('child_process');const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));let remote='';try{remote=cp.execFileSync('git',['config','--get','remote.origin.url'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()}catch{}if(remote&&!/(?:github\\.com[/:])physicsbasit-debug\\/wathiq(?:\\.git)?$/i.test(remote)){console.error('ABORT: this bootstrap is only for physicsbasit-debug/wathiq');process.exit(2)}const data=JSON.parse(zlib.gunzipSync(Buffer.from(pkg.wathiqUpdatePayload,'base64')).toString('utf8'));if(data.version!=='0.2.0'||!data.files||typeof data.files!=='object')throw new Error('Invalid Wathiq 0.2.0 payload');const root=path.resolve('.');for(const name of fs.readdirSync('.')){if(name==='.git'||name==='node_modules')continue;if(name==='.github'){for(const child of fs.readdirSync('.github')){if(child==='workflows')continue;fs.rmSync(path.join('.github',child),{recursive:true,force:true})}continue}fs.rmSync(name,{recursive:true,force:true})}for(const [rel,b64] of Object.entries(data.files)){if(rel.startsWith('.github/workflows/'))continue;const dest=path.resolve(rel);if(!(dest===root||dest.startsWith(root+path.sep)))throw new Error('Unsafe payload path: '+rel);fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(dest,Buffer.from(b64,'base64'))}console.log('WATHIQ RESET 0.2.0 SAFE: synchronized '+Object.keys(data.files).length+' canonical files; preserved .github/workflows.');"
scripts.check: npm run repo:clean && npm run check
scripts.build: npm run repo:clean && npm run build
